about: Same five-step ladder as reviews.json (see its 'about'). {X} = the name he picks or types; {a}/{plural} = the kind of thing. 'against' marks the other side (the empty square on the card). · 25 Nov 2026 (the owner, after the content check): every way is a phrase the task's own model texts use (the Model and Guided/Sample steps), three alternatives per move, the moves in the models' order, so Basics teaches what the practice shows. · 'example' on a subject: the five sentences finished for its first answer (eg), each starting with its move's first way; Basics shows them on its card (25 Nov 2026, the owner: immediately likeable).
name: Report
how: A report in five sentences, as the model reports do: the aim, what was generally felt, the main concern, your recommendation, and the conclusion.

nameAsk.title: On what?
nameAsk.aim: Pick something at your school or in your town. You’ll report on it.

notebook: Write your report on {X} in five sentences, with a heading for each part. Then check:
ticks: I said the aim in my first sentence.
I used a heading for each part.
I reported what people said, not just my opinion.

subjects.label: A school facility
example: The main objective of this report is to assess the school library.
It was generally felt that the school library is a quiet place to study.
However, one major concern expressed by students is that it closes too early.
In order to address these issues, I would recommend opening it until six o'clock.
Taking everything into account, it seems clear that small changes would help everyone.

subjects.label: A school trip
subjects.eg: the trip to the science museum
picks: the trip to the science museum
example: The main objective of this report is to assess the trip to the science museum.
It was generally felt that the trip to the science museum was interesting.
However, one major concern expressed by students is that the visit was too short.
In order to address these issues, I would recommend a full day next year.
Taking everything into account, it seems clear that the trip should be repeated.

subjects.label: A club
example: The main objective of this report is to assess the youth club.
It was generally felt that the youth club is a friendly place to meet.
However, one major concern expressed by students is that there are few activities.
In order to address these issues, I would recommend adding sports and music.
Taking everything into account, it seems clear that the club has great potential.

subjects.label: An event
example: The main objective of this report is to assess the school festival.
It was generally felt that the school festival was a great success.
However, one major concern expressed by students is that the queues for food were long.
In order to address these issues, I would recommend more food stalls.
Taking everything into account, it seems clear that the festival should happen every year.

subjects.label: Your town
example: The main objective of this report is to assess the town centre.
It was generally felt that the town centre is safe and clean.
However, one major concern expressed by students is that there is nowhere for young people to go.
In order to address these issues, I would recommend opening a youth café.
Taking everything into account, it seems clear that young people need more space.
